title: Captain's Noticeboard
text: A new page - the Captain's Noticeboard - has been added to the Members-Only part of the website. Please check it, as it has important information on the CompassSport Final & the next club kit order. Don't forget you'll need to be logged in to access it. The website allows you to re-set a forgotten password, but please contact web_chris@suffoc.co.uk if you have any further difficulties when trying to log in.
